The '''De'etta system''' was in [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sanbra]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Callow Batta]] was seen in the De'etta system.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
